create_body: This browser will make your account''s encryption keys. They''re backed up locked with your password, so a new device needs your password and a code sent to your email. You''ll also get a recovery key for when the email can''t work, for example after a password reset.
reveal_sub: It''s shown only now. You''ll need it if you can''t get into your email, or after a password reset.
reveal_warning: Anyone with this key can read your messages. Keep it private, in a password manager or on paper.
reveal_stored: I''ve stored my recovery key somewhere safe.
setup_sub: Signed in as {email}. To read your messages here, this browser needs your account''s keys.
setup_checking: Checking for a backup of your keys…
setup_code_sent: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}.
setup_fixed_code: Enter the 6-digit tester code you were given. No email is sent for this account.
setup_no_code: This account needs no code: your password unlocks your messages.
setup_password_hint: Your password opens the backup in this browser.
setup_other_ways: Other ways to unlock: if the email code can''t reach you, use one of these.
setup_no_backup: There''s no key backup for your current password (for example after a password reset), so use your phone or your recovery key.
setup_check_failed: Couldn''t check whether your keys are backed up. Try again, or use another way below.
setup_ways: How to set up this browser
setup_recovery_hint: It stays in this browser: only a signature made with it is sent.
setup_recovery_bad: That recovery key isn''t complete or has a typo. Check it and try again.
phone_step_open_sub: Go to Settings › Devices and tap Approve new device.
phone_step_check: Check the device key, then approve
phone_step_check_sub: Your phone shows a device key. It must match this one exactly:
phone_waiting: Waiting for your phone to approve…
